identification: Framed John Eldershaw (1892-1973) c1930s woodcut-style bookplate print of Ross Bridge, Tasmania, titled 'Ross Bridge - Tasmania' in pencil lower left and signed 'John Eldershaw' in pencil lower right, gilt frame, black mount with gold slip. Same series as the many Eldershaw Tasmanian bookplates (GPO, Old Treasury Steps, Gorge Mill) regularly sold at Gowans. Ross Bridge is a popular subject but no earlier sale of this exact title was found.

viewing_check: Check the pencil signature and title are genuinely in pencil (not printed), look for plate mark or embossing, any toning or foxing at the mat edges, and whether the sheet is a true bookplate size. Ask for the back of the frame to see if there is a dealer label or date.
